summary: Iteration 17 — Multi-store bookings (Phase 1 Branded Flow Hardening) verified end-to-end. Ran the golden-file DB suite (5/5 pass), wrote /app/app/backend/tests/test_iteration17_multistore_booking_live.py (8 live-API tests, 8/8 pass against preview) covering booking create with per-line store + default-inherit + invalid-id fail-safe, pending scope any-line-in-scope for deo.cashier, GRN _resolve_booking 403 on out-of-scope booking + 201 for owner, and direct-receipt (no booking) scoping still intact. Frontend Playwright: owner logged in, /documents/bookings/new form filled with default DEO + line0=Default/line1=BKR → saved → detail page renders 'Destination' column with X1=Deoghar (inherited) and X2=Bokaro (override). Seeded BK-SS26-0001 detail also shows shirts→Deoghar (inherited) and trousers→Bokaro (override) as specified.
action_items: None. Multi-store booking feature (per-line store override, any-line-in-scope receive scope, direct-receipt unaffected) is behaving exactly as specified in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingLineSerializer correctly exposes `store` (raw FK id, nullable) and `store_name` (from store.name, default None) — inherited-default lines round-trip as store=null/store_name=null; the UI falls back to booking.destination_store_name (BookingDetailPage line 333: `l.store_name ?? b.destination_store_name ?? 'Warehouse'`).

BookingListCreateView.create validates per-line store ids against Store.objects in a single set query, then falls back to None for unknown ids (line 156). Confirmed live: POST with `store: 999999` → 201 and the line comes back with store=null (fail-safe, not an error). No N+1: `Store.objects.filter(pk__in=requested).values_list('id', flat=True)` runs once regardless of line count.

PendingBookingsView store filter is exactly the any-line-in-scope contract: `Q(lines__store_id__in=ids) | Q(lines__store__isnull=True, destination_store_id__in=ids)` with .distinct() to avoid multi-line duplicates. Fail-closed for warehouse/HO-bound lines (both store_id AND destination_store_id null → never in any ids set).

_booking_touches_stores() computes the effective destination per line (own store OR booking default) and set-intersects with the user's visible stores — matches the review request wording exactly. _resolve_booking short-circuits when booking_id is absent, so direct receipts keep GrnListCreateView's own scope path (scope_by_store + _resolve_receiving_store) untouched — confirmed live (deo.cashier direct GRN into DEO=201, into BKR=403).

Booking querysets are correctly prefetch-optimised — `.prefetch_related('lines', 'lines__store')` on both BookingListCreateView.get_queryset and BookingDetailView.queryset, so per-line store_name resolves without an N+1 on lines. PendingBookingsView applies the same prefetch after the distinct() filter.

Frontend Bookings.tsx per-line Store select is clean: value='' → 'Default' (empty string round-trips to backend as no store → inherit), and each real store shown as `code` only (compact for tables). The detail view's Destination column falls back to booking default name for inherited lines — matches the UX contract that a blank line should never look 'unassigned'.

Booking number allocation went through VoucherSeries.allocate (gap-free per FY/season) — the new booking created by the Playwright run was 26-27/SS26/BK/3, confirming the count()+1 race fix noted in vendors/views.py:54-61 is in effect.

success_rate.backend: 100% — 5/5 DB golden tests + 8/8 live-API tests pass (13/13 total)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — new-booking form + save + detail Destination column verified on both a fresh booking and the seeded BK-SS26-0001
